args: exec playwright-mcp --cdp-endpoint http://127.0.0.1:9222 --secrets <(printf "%s='%s'\n" SITE_PASSWORD "$SITE_PASSWORD" QUOTED "$QUOTED" HASHY "$HASHY")
exec playwright-mcp --cdp-endpoint http://127.0.0.1:9222 --secrets <(printf '%s=%s\n' SITE_PASSWORD "$SITE_PASSWORD" QUOTED "$QUOTED" HASHY "$HASHY")

f=/dev/shm/pwmcp-secrets.env; (umask 077; printf '%s="%s"\n' SITE_PASSWORD "$SITE_PASSWORD" QUOTED "$QUOTED" HASHY "$HASHY" > $f); exec playwright-mcp --cdp-endpoint http://127.0.0.1:9222 --secrets $f

f=$(mktemp /dev/shm/pw.XXXXXX); printf "%s='%s'\n" SITE_PASSWORD "$SITE_PASSWORD" QUOTED "$QUOTED" HASHY "$HASHY" > $f; exec 3<$f; rm $f; exec playwright-mcp --cdp-endpoint http://127.0.0.1:9222 --secrets /dev/fd/3
